tools.name: get_course
tools.description: Get full details for a single course by its courseId (as returned by search_courses). Use this to read fees, prerequisites, career outcomes and provider info before enquiring.

courseId.description: The courseId from search_courses (Qdrant point id / WP post id)

tools.name: search_courses
tools.description: Search CourseFinder for nationally recognised Australian courses. Hybrid keyword + semantic search over the live index. Understands natural language (e.g. 'free online diploma of aged care in Brisbane'): it auto-detects study mode, qualification level, government funding and location. Returns courses with a courseId to pass to submit_course_enquiry.

query.description: Natural language search, e.g. 'aged care courses' or 'online diploma of nursing'

limit.description: Max number of courses to return (default 8)

qualification.description: Filter by qualification level, e.g. 'Diploma', 'Certificate IV', 'Bachelor'

tools.name: submit_course_enquiry
tools.description: Submit a course enquiry to CourseFinder on the user's behalf. Calling without confirm returns a preview listing the fields still required - collect those from the user, then call again with confirm:true to create a real lead. The preview's `form` field describes this course's specific requirements: some courses only accept leads from certain states/postcodes or within a distance of the campus, and postgraduate courses require confirming prerequisites (qualification_confirmed), so always check the preview first. phone_number must be a valid Australian mobile (04XXXXXXXX or +614XXXXXXXX). Always show the preview and get explicit user approval before submitting with confirm:true.

first_name.description: Required to submit. Applicant first name

last_name.description: Required to submit. Applicant last name

email_address.description: Required to submit. Applicant email address

phone_number.description: Required to submit. Australian mobile, e.g. 0412345678 or +61412345678

state.description: Required to submit. State/territory of residence, e.g. 'NSW', 'VIC', 'QLD'

suburb_or_postcode.description: Australian suburb or postcode. Required when the preview's form.location_gate is not 'none' (location-restricted courses).

start_timeframe.description: Required to submit. When the user wants to start studying.

enquiry_reasons.description: Required to submit (at least one). Reasons for the enquiry. If 'Other (please specify)' is included, put the detail in enquiry_message.

enquiry_message.description: Free-text message / questions for the provider

qualification_confirmed.description: Required for postgraduate courses (see the preview's form.requires_qualification_check). Set true only after the user confirms they meet the entry prerequisites shown in form.prerequisites.

prequalify_acknowledged.description: Required when the preview returns form.prequalify_text. Set true only after the user acknowledges that text.

confirm.description: Set true ONLY after the user approves the preview. Defaults to false (preview only).
